description: No API key, no login. Address to coordinates and back from 10 official government address registers: US Census, Canada NRCan, UK ONS postcodes, France BAN, Spain CartoCiudad, Netherlands BAG, Switzerland, Norway, Estonia, Poland. Open licences: you may store the results. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/official-geocoding-api.

addresses.description: Addresses, postcodes or place names, up to 100 per run. The country is detected from the text (postcode format, city or country name). To force it, set Country below or prefix one line like 'FR: 8 bd du Port, 80000 Amiens'. Covered: US, CA,

coordinates.description: Optional points as 'lat,lon', e.g. 52.3759,4.8975. Returns the nearest official address (FR, ES, NL, NO, PL), the nearest postcode (GB) or the county and census tract (US).

country.description: Optional: one country for all lines (US, CA, GB, FR, ES, NL, CH, NO, EE, PL). Leave 'auto' to detect it per line.

includeCensus.description: For US addresses also return state, county and census tract FIPS codes (GEOID) from the Census Bureau. Useful for demographics joins, insurance and lending (HMDA/CRA) work.
